import z3
import time

n = 6
N = n * n  # 36

# Create variables for the grid
grid = [[z3.Int(f"cell_{i}_{j}") for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]

# Each cell is between 1 and 36
cell_constraints = [z3.And(1 <= grid[i][j], grid[i][j] <= N) for i in range(n) for j in range(n)]

# All distinct
distinct = z3.Distinct([grid[i][j] for i in range(n) for j in range(n)])

# Row sums
row_sums = [z3.Sum([grid[i][j] for j in range(n)]) for i in range(n)]

# Column sums
col_sums = [z3.Sum([grid[i][j] for i in range(n)]) for j in range(n)]

# Diagonals
main_diag = z3.Sum([grid[i][i] for i in range(n)])
anti_diag = z3.Sum([grid[i][n-1-i] for i in range(n)])

# All 14 sums
all_sums = row_sums + col_sums + [main_diag, anti_diag]

# They must be 14 consecutive integers
# Let S be the minimum sum
S = z3.Int('S')
consecutive = z3.And([all_sums[k] == S + k for k in range(14)])

# Solve
solver = z3.Solver()
solver.add(cell_constraints)
solver.add(distinct)
solver.add(consecutive)

print("Solving...")
start = time.time()
result = solver.check()
print(f"Result: {result}, time: {time.time() - start:.2f}s")

if result == z3.sat:

    # Extract sums
